Mali reports coordinated rebel attacks across multiple towns

Mali's government has reported that insurgents launched coordinated attacks targeting several towns in the northern and central regions of the country. The Malian army stated the situation was under control, while a rebel group claimed responsibility for some attacks, including one on a northern town where Malian troops and Russian fighters are reportedly based. The assaults come amid an ongoing security crisis in Mali.
